notes.title: Major Atlas Mystery Update
notes.content:
[h1]The Atlas Mystery – Major Update (Hint System + Quality of Life Improvements)[/h1]

Dear Players,

We are thrilled to announce the latest major update to [i]The Atlas Mystery[/i]—an exciting new feature that enhances gameplay, making the experience even more immersive and enjoyable! After closely monitoring player feedback and hearing your thoughts, we've been hard at work implementing changes that will elevate your adventure to new heights.

Here’s a breakdown of what you can expect in this update:

[h2]Introducing the New Intuitive Hint System[/h2]

One of the most requested features has now been added: a completely revamped, intuitive hint system designed to assist players in their journey through The Atlas Mystery without taking away the sense of discovery. We understand that unraveling the story behind the mysterious Atlas Theater can be challenging, and this system will help guide you through the more intricate puzzles while keeping the atmosphere and immersion intact.

How does it work?

Dynamic Suggestions: When you’re stuck on a puzzle or unsure of what to do next, the hint system will give you subtle, in-context nudges based on your current location and the puzzles you’ve solved so far. The hints will never give away the solution outright, so your sense of accomplishment remains intact.

Non-Intrusive Design: The hint system is completely optional and non-invasive. Hints can be accessed through a simple button prompt, allowing players to choose when and how much help they need.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41415822/5e52d99ef27adffafbd26031a96e1dcecac4079d.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41415822/3c6d5e0b8dcf3528155e88158eae17966db6494a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Quality of Life Improvements[/h2]

In addition to the hint system, we’ve made numerous quality of life updates that enhance gameplay fluidity and overall enjoyment. These improvements come directly from community feedback and our team's desire to polish every aspect of the game:

Refined Movement Controls: We’ve smoothed out the movement mechanics, making locomotion around the Atlas Theater more intuitive and less jarring. Whether you're using teleport or smooth movement, the experience should now feel much more natural.

Improved Interaction System: Picking up and interacting with objects in the environment has been optimized for better precision and fewer accidental actions. This will make puzzle-solving smoother, with fewer interruptions to your experience.

Enhanced Visual and Audio Cues: We’ve added subtle visual and audio cues that make navigating the theater and understanding puzzle mechanics easier, without detracting from the eerie atmosphere of the game. These cues will help guide you to important objects and areas without breaking immersion.

Revamped Tutorial: Based on player feedback, we’ve reworked the introductory tutorial to better explain the game’s mechanics while keeping the pace brisk. New players will find the game easier to grasp, while returning players can still dive right into the story.

Optimized Performance: We’ve fine-tuned the game for better performance on a range of systems, reducing loading times and increasing frame rates. Whether you’re playing on high-end hardware or something more modest, the game should now run smoother than ever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41415822/3ab69a37414085c3f9f610d83bd4b231de88777b.png[/img]
[h2]
A Message of Gratitude[/h2]

We want to take a moment to express our deep gratitude to our incredible community. Your tenacity, creativity, and loyalty have helped shape The Atlas Mystery into what it is today. From the feedback on our forums to the detailed bug reports and feature suggestions, your involvement has been invaluable. We hear you, and we're committed to continually improving the game based on your input.

We know the journey through the Atlas Theater has been challenging, but it’s your dedication that has pushed us to make these enhancements. As we look ahead, rest assured that we’ll continue to refine the game and introduce new features that further enrich the experience.

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]

Stay tuned—this update is just the beginning. We’ve got more content planned for the future, including additional story elements, expanded puzzle mechanics, and even new areas to explore. If you have suggestions or feedback on this update, don’t hesitate to share them with us. We’re always listening and excited to see what ideas you come up with.

Thank you for being a part of The Atlas Mystery! We can’t wait to see how you enjoy the new hint system and improvements.

See you in the Atlas Theater!

[b]— The Atlas Mystery Development Team[/b]

notes.title: ATLAS MYSTERY - New Updates Available!
notes.content:
Greetings Atlas patrons!

The team at [url=www.toprightcorner.com][b]Top Right Corner [/b][/url]is dedicated to ensuring your experience at our historic Atlas Theater is a memorable one, so we are proud to introduce a host of both gameplay and graphics improvements!

Our halls have grown richer in visual detail, and you’ll find a variety of inventory, saving, and mechanics improvements to ensure you remain seamlessly immersed in one of the top VR escape room experiences out there.

And for our aspiring sleuths and private eyes - you can finally wear the hat in the Employee Lounge, for extra motivation as you crack the most heinous case in Hollywood history :tophat:
Keep your eyes peeled for future updates… including some new layers to the mystery that might require further exploration of the abandoned theater…
Enjoy your time exploring the Atlas!

Patch notes:
		[list]
[*] Improved Visuals throughout the theatre
[*] 		Improved optimization
[*] 		Improved In-Game Menu
[*] 		Improvements to Inventory system
[*] 		Made Keys easier to use
[*] 		Fixed various menu/loading bugs
[*] 		Added the ability to grab various puzzle elements that were non-grabbable before
[*] 		Made the Hat in the Lounge wearable
[*] 		Made Theatre doors open both ways
[*] 		Made it harder to teleport to areas you should not be
[*] 		Various save and loading fixes
[*] 		Wiped all saves to allow for improved saving system
[*] 		Made it harder to lose required items (reloading should ALWAYS give return items to your inventory if you have previously collected them)
[*] 		Various bug fixes to puzzles
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: Steam VR Showcase Game Update July 7.15.22
notes.content:
In advance of the Steam VR Showcase launching in a few days, we are posting a new version updated based on feedback from the Steam Summer sale. Thanks again for all of your feedback. Sometimes making small changes can make a huge difference. 

Here are some of the changes:


[list]
[*] Collision improvements on certain items
[*] Minor visual improvements
[*] Improved Radio Puzzle usability
[*] Fixed item gravity bug
[*] Improved certain key usability
[*] Changed noise when putting key into backpack
[*] Fixed being able to teleport with certain items you were not meant to
[*] Minor performance improvements
[*] Added some clarity to tutorial
[/list]

If you have any (spoiler free) feedback for the Top Right Corner team on [i]The Atlas Mystery,[/i] please let us know! We love making VR games for you!

notes.title: Atlas Hot Fix v1.6
notes.content:
As a lover of puzzles, escape rooms and VR in general, the creators of [i]The Atlas Mystery [/i] will continue to support and improve this game over time. As we get set for the Steam Summer Sale, we wanted to push the following slight improvements after listening to user feedback. Thank you for the all of the comments and feedback on the game. 

[list]
[*] - Improved floor texture on quest
[*] - Made UI laser pointer come out of finger
[*] - Fixed floor Z fighting issues
[*] - Made force grab range lower to reduce accidentally grabbing far away objects
[/list]

We're planning some larger improvements to the game in general but as an indie game, we need your help. If you enjoyed the game, please leave us a positive review on Steam and share it while its on sale with any VR enthusiast friends. As developers, we want to expand the puzzles and deepen the mystery at [i]The Atlas![/i]

notes.title: Atlas Hot Fix v1.5
notes.content:
We love the feedback we've been getting from the customers at the [i]Atlas. [/i]

Some of our foreign audience members have run into some rare bugs (due to how systems are configured internationally) that we fixed along the way in addition to some tweaks that just made gameplay better. We hope that some of our German and French players who were disproportionately affected will give us another chance! ːsteamhappyː

Many of you - especially you loyal streamers - have asked for sound settings in the menu. These have now been added!

[list]
[*] - Fixed continue button not working in rare cases
[*] - Fixed loading in incorrect location for non-NA/UK players
[*] - Added collider to Grandfather clock
[*] - Fixed misspelling in a clue
[*] - Added Sound settings to menu
[*] - Fixed prop-surfing on silverware
[/list]

We LOVE escape rooms and puzzle games. At Top Right Corner, we want to bring you more and to expand [b]The Atlas Mystery[/b] as we go. 

Over the past month we've now updated the game five times with patches and HotFixes. Cumulatively, the game is much better than what we first released and we have our loyal patrons to thank for this thorough feedback. 

If there's anything else you'd like to see from us or something that could improve the experience, please let us know!

-The Atlas Theater Staff

notes.title: Atlas Hot Fix v1.4
notes.content:
Hello Loyal Atlas Patrons,

Building an VR indie game that is meant to function seamlessly on Meta Quest, Steam VR and Viveport is a challenge. There have been a few bumps along the road but we cannot stress how much we appreciate your notes and feedback. Many of you have taken the time to send us specific bugs and video captures that have led directly to these fixes. Thank you!

There have been a few saving / loading issues where players have spawned in voids that we've addressed. Please take a look at the list below and message our development team if there's something you'd like added for our next patch. 

Additionally, many of you have pointed out the desire for [b]achievements[/b] and we have added some public and secret discoveries for players to find when they explore the Atlas. 

[list]
[*] Made Elevator door open automatically when unlocked
[*] Added safeguard to spawning outside of the map / endlessly falling into black void 
[*] Added Achievements!
[*] Minor updates to hand position fixes
[*] Fixed Jittering/stuttering at higher frame rates (PC ONLY)
[*] Made sure Employee lounge door stays unlocked after loading
[*] Minor clipping fixes
[*] Fixed clue in lobby disappearing on load
[*] Improved textures of a few puzzles (PC only) 
[*] Fixed flashlight working weirdly on load
[*] Fixed lighting issue in auditorium on load
[/list]

We will continue to roll out updates for [i]The Atlas Mystery[/i] over the coming weeks. Thanks for your help and support!

notes.title: Atlas Hot Fix v1.3
notes.content:
The Atlas Theater has been abandoned for over a decade, but this doesn't mean its staff is not hard at work behind the scenes to bring you the best gameplay experience possible. 

Just in time for the weekend, we present the following small fixes and improvements in gameplay for [i]The Atlas Mystery. [/i]

As an independent movie theater chain without a ton of resources, your feedback is immensely appreciated and we've tried to incorporate as much as possible into your Atlas experience. 

[b]Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] Interaction Circles no longer appear behind walls/doors
[*] Added Crouch Button to Tutorial
[*] Let's just say the candy bar puzzle is better...
[*] Added additional narrative loading screens when loading an existing game
[*] Addressed feedback on the soda machine
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added protections from getting out of bounds
[*] Addressed weird physics with a specific auditorium clue 
[*] Fixed documents with high aliasing
[*] Made placed safe knobs save their location properly
[*] Fixed a couple walls you could teleport through
[*] Made force grab smoother and easier to use
[*] Minor physics updates to some puzzles
[*] Fixed some rare saving issues
[/list]

Stayed tuned for [b]Achievements[/b] next week!

notes.title: Coming Attractions from the Atlas Staff - UPDATED 4.28.22
notes.content:
UPDATE - 4.28.22

We've just launched a series of updates including [b]achievements![/b]

Explore its haunted halls for the first time or take another spin through the Atlas and see if you can collect them all as you unravel its mysteries. 

***


UPDATE - 4.25.22

The Atlas Staff is launching a new update this Wednesday, April 27th to its loyal patrons:

[list]
[*] A round of Steam Achievements including a series of hidden/mystery items
[*] Upgraded support for Index headsets and SteamVR in general
[*] Some tweaks to the save and load systems that were giving some PCVR users issues
[*] Fixes to some rare bugs that affect Viveport users
[*] Document jitter fix on systems with higher frame rates
[/list]
Our goal as developers to continue to expand and roll out updates to this game over time. We appreciate your continued support. 

Stay tuned!

***


Hello Atlas Patrons!

We’re excited to announce that we will be rolling out some additional gameplay improvements over the next few days with HotFix V1.3, to further refine the Airlink/Virtual Desktop capabilities and enhance some in-game mechanics. We want your visit to The Atlas to be the most refined and pleasant experience that it can be!

We’re also thrilled to announce that we will introduce ACHIEVEMENTS next week! We’ve lined up some interesting challenges that will surely put your escape room capabilities to the test.

We’re overwhelmed by the great reception we’ve been receiving over our first week, and look forward to continuing to enhance and expand your theater-going experience!

-The Atlas Staff
